sloka: लङ्का दृष्टा मया स्वप्ने रावणेनाभिरक्षिता ।दग्धा रामस्य दूतेन वानरेण तरस्विना ।। ५.२७.३६।।।।
transliteration: laṅkā dṛṣṭā mayā svapne rāvaṇenābhirakṣitā ।dagdhā rāmasya dūtena vānareṇa tarasvinā ।। 5.27.36।।।।

translations.english: In my dream I saw this city of Lanka protected by Ravana burnt down by a powerful vanara , a messenger of Rama.
